name: Webb's Killed Paragraph
description:
Silas Webb submitted a detailed account of the Ripper's wound pattern for the January edition. Arthur Crane removed the paragraph before publication. The specific detail — a secondary incision pattern — was never printed anywhere.

The copycat's staging of Clara's murder used this same pattern correctly.

Only someone who saw Webb's original copy before Crane cut it would know to use it.
journal_entry: Arthur cut Webb's paragraph. The copycat used the detail from that paragraph. Arthur had that information. No one else at the paper would have thought to use it. Arthur.
